source_title: Vinay Rajani expects Nifty to rally above 22,800; shares 2 stock ideas - Business Standard
source_excerpt: Disclaimer: Views and outlook in this report belong to the brokerages and analysts cited. They do not reflect the views of Business Standard. Readers are advised to exercise discretion. Vinay Rajani, CMT, Senior Technical Analyst, HDFC securities Nifty View After yesterday's smart recovery from lower levels, Nifty ended flat at 22,749. The 20-DEMA at 22,824 acted as a key intraday hurdle, and the index reversed lower after testing it. However, Nifty held comfortably above yesterday’s swing low, retaining its short-term strength. The 22,370–22,400 zone remains an important support band.
